about: The introitus of the formulary “13th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Have regard for Your covenant, O Lord, and do not abandon forever the souls of Your poor. Arise, O Lord, and judge Your own cause, and do not forget the voices of those who seek You. Why, O God, have You cast us off forever? Why has Your fury raged against the sheep of Your pasture? Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Have regard for Your covenant, O Lord, and do not abandon forever the souls of Your poor. Arise, O Lord, and judge Your own cause, and do not forget the voices of those who seek You.
